blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Southeast Asian parliamentary leaders and officials paid a courtesy call on Philippine House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III on Tuesday, a day before the formal opening of the 47th Asean Inter-Parliamentary Assembly (Aipa), which is headed by Dy as president. The event — took place at the Makati Shangi-La Hotel, where the group posed for photographs — was attended by the following. READ: Dy calls on Asean lawmakers to help strengthen regional coop /atm...
